name: 796-kinds-ruling-10-one-list-grouped-in-two-cases-loads
models:
module core
version 0.1.0
distribution public
source "probe"
key uid string -
key time_ms int ms
module probe
version 0.1.0
distribution public
source "probe"
key x int -
key y int -
key z int -
key a float -
key s string -
key label string -
list items "a list"
pack:
format probe
version 0.20.0
distribution public
source "probe"
uses probe
wire bits
layout sequential
field probe.x 8 uint
switch probe.x
  case 1
    group probe.items count 8
      field probe.y 8 uint
    end
  case 2
    group probe.items count 8
      field probe.y 16 uint
    end
  else
    group probe.items while
      field probe.y 4 uint
    end
end
